rows.definition: The Thinking Machines Inkling-2 looped MoE family (model_type inkling2_loop): 24 stored layers in six-layer attention-residual blocks, where the middle blocks run several passes per token with gated cross-pass messages. Spine and typed refusal live in internal/model/inkling2loop_spine.go; the host reference forward in internal/model/inkling2loop_forward.go; the GGUF binding in internal/ggufload/inkling2loop.go.
rows.distinction: A MODEL ARCHITECTURE loop (re-running stored transformer layers within one token's forward), not an agent, scheduler or retry loop: nothing iterates over turns, requests or attempts, and the pass count is a checkpoint hyperparameter.

rows.definition: The rank (64 for Inkling-2-Mini) of the low-rank cross-pass controller in an inkling2_loop checkpoint: each controller projects the normalized (input, message) pair down to GateRank, then up to tanh gain and forget gates that mix the previous pass's message into a looped layer's input.
rows.distinction: A NEURAL GATE's projection width inside the model forward, not an admission, policy or CI gate: it decides nothing about whether work may proceed and is read from loop_config.gate_rank / inkling2_loop.loop.gate_rank.
